'''Raxxus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He fell out of favor with the [[Dark Council]] and was imprisoned in the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. He was later killed by a group of Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] hired by Lord [[Darth Shaar|Shaar]].<ref name="TOR" />
